title: flash_fraq: fragmentomics-first ctDNA tumor fraction estimation from low-pass cfDNA
description: A Snakemake pipeline and gradient-boosting regressor that predicts continuous ctDNA tumor fraction from low-pass cell-free DNA copy-number and fragment-size features, trained on in silico admixtures of HCC1395 tumor reads into cfDNA backgrounds and benchmarked against ichorCNA. Research use only; not clinically validated.
